fields.label: API key
fields.description: In Audienceful: Settings → API → Generate key. Use a separate Audienceful workspace for your Swell test environment.

fields.label: Sync customers
fields.description: New and updated customers become Audienceful contacts, tagged swell-customer, with their name, address, order count and total spent. Customers who opted in to marketing are also tagged marketing-consent. Customers who withdraw consent are unsubscribed.

fields.label: Include customers who didn't opt in
fields.description: Off: only customers who agreed to receive marketing emails are synced. On: every customer with an email is synced and subscribed in Audienceful. Check that you're allowed to email them (in the EU, marketing emails usually need consent), and use the marketing-consent tag to send newsletters only to customers who opted in.
